Porsche 911 with interior (911 Turbo S)
Author: n.brizitskaya
Source: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/porsche-911-with-interior-877b1bc1739f4a2bb65d62fd7ffd9f75
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Changes for Dream Garage study, 2026-10-30:
Closed the source's posed door using its mirrored closed transform;
applied one rigid axis rotation and uniform scale to 4.535m length;
separated four wheels, stationary brake groups and the steering wheel;
preserved all 423947 source triangles;
quantized positions, normals and tangents; reduced mobile texture resolution;
applied Ferrari-reference paint in the preview and allowed rim recoloring;
gzip transport encoding. Original-resolution textures are available separately.
The original author does not endorse this study.
